[D16:19] John: Yeah, Maria! We're really making progress towards making a positive impact. I believe in us! See ya!
Session date: 11:51 am on 3 June, 2023
[D17:1] John: Hey Maria, long time no talk! Life's been pretty wild lately. The toughest thing to deal with is that we had to say goodbye to Max. He was such an important part of our family for 10 years and it's so hard to think he's not here wagging that tail anymore.
[D17:2] Maria: John, I'm sorry to hear about Max. It can be tough to lose a pet - they're like family. How have you been coping?
[D17:3] John: Hey Maria, thanks for the kind words. We're all still sad about it, but have been comforted by the good times we had and the memories we have. It's tough, but we'll keep doing our best.
[D17:4] Maria: Good to hear that you're finding comfort in the good times you had with Max. Pets really have a way of touching our hearts. Do you have any pictures you'd like to share?
[D17:5] John: Let's make sure we make progress in the coming weeks to ensure that we honor the memories of our loved ones. Here's a picture of him that I cherish. 
[D17:6] Maria: Max looks so peaceful in that photo, just chilling in the backyard. It's nice to remember him like that. It's a great way to honor him.
[D17:7] John: Yeah, that's how we'll think of him - peaceful and happy. He brought us so much joy. It's heartbreaking that he's gone but we're grateful to have had him as part of our family. He taught us a lot about love and loyalty.
[D17:8] Maria: Max was truly awesome. Let's cherish the lessons he taught.
[D17:9] John: He really taught us the importance of unconditional love and loyalty. I want my kids to learn that too. Our bond with him was so special and something I cherish.
[...]
[D17:12] Maria: John, that's such a great idea! It gives the pup a loving home and teaches your kids important values. If you need any help, let me know! I just started volunteering at a local dog shelter once a month.
[D17:13] John: Thanks for the offer, Maria! It's so awesome to have friends like you. If we need help, we'll let you know. Appreciate it!

Session date: 8:06 pm on 9 August, 2023

Session date: 12:10 am on 11 August, 2023
[D30:1] Maria: Hey John! Long time no talk! Guess what - I got a puppy two weeks ago! Her name's Coco and she's adorable.
[D30:2] John: Wow, Maria! Coco looks so adorable! She seems so happy in that photo. How's it been having her around?
[D30:3] Maria: Thanks, John! It really brings joy to my life; she's always there to greet me when I come home. It's definitely been an adjustment taking care of her, but it's totally worth it!
[D30:4] John: That's great! Pets are the best for lifting our spirits. I'm always still thinking about Max- here's a pic of him.
[D30:5] Maria: Aww, he looks so cute in that pic! He obviously brought you lots of joy. What's your best memory with him?
[D30:6] John: Thanks, Maria! Max and I had a blast on our camping trip last summer. We hiked, swam, and made great memories. It was a really peaceful and awesome experience.
[D30:7] Maria: Wow, John, sounds like you and Max had a great time! Camping with pets can be so soul-nourishing, right?
[D30:8] John: Definitely, Maria! It was so chill. Being out in nature, away from all the noise and taking some quality time was great. It was a nice break from the everyday hustle and bustle. 
[...]

Session date: 2:47 pm on 12 June, 2023
[D18:1] Maria: Hey John, how're you doing? I'm sorry about Max. Losing a pet is tough. Some friends from church and I went camping last weekend - it was a blast! Just something nice to take my mind off things. Anything fun in your life lately?
[D18:2] John: Hey Maria, thanks for your kind words. It's still tough, but I'm finding some comfort in the good memories. Wow, your camping trip sounds awesome! I went on a mountaineering trip last week with some workmates. It was great and helped clear my head. Anything else cool happening in your life?
[D18:3] Maria: Glad you're finding comfort, John. That mountaineering trip sounds amazing. Did you reach the summit? When I was younger, my family and I went on a road trip to Oregon.
[D18:4] John: Thanks, Maria! Yeah, we made it to the top and the view was stunning. It was tough but awesome. Your family trip must have been great too, right? What was the prettiest spot?
[D18:5] Maria: Hiking to the top and seeing this was awesome! Breath-taking.
[...]
[D18:21] Maria: Wow! Looks like you had fun - what happened there?
[D18:22] John: It was an awesome day at the park with my family. The kids had a lot of fun on the playground, and we had some really nice family time.
[D18:23] Maria: Wow, that's great to hear, John! Cherish those family time moments!
